summary: Unexpected post-rollout credit memo applied to prior invoice causing balance confusion
description:
Issue summary: Customer BrightHealth AI contacted Support after noticing an unexpected credit memo posted on 2026-03-09 that retroactively adjusted a Feb invoice (INV-2026-02-15-001). They were previously charged and reported the Feb invoice as reconciled in their ERP; the new credit appears to reduce that historical invoice and created a negative balance on their account statement.

Impact: Customer finance team is unable to reconcile month-end numbers; they are pausing upcoming committed capacity increases until ledger is clarified. Customer requests explanation, audit trail, and confirmation that no double-refund/duplicate adjustment will be applied.

Environment: Redwood hosted billing system; customer is on Dedicated plan tied to org ID org-brighthealth-01; metering shows normal usage patterns around the Feb rollout of open-llama-13b-v2.

Initial customer-provided artifacts: invoice PDF INV-2026-02-15-001, credit memo CM-2026-03-09-77, billing export CSV (billing_export_2026-03-10.csv), and screenshot of account statement.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Login to Redwood Console as account admin (BrightHealth Finance).
2) Navigate to Billing > Invoices and select INV-2026-02-15-001.
3) Observe line items and see an attached credit memo CM-2026-03-09-77 with date 2026-03-09.
4) Download account statement and note negative balance entry for the same period.
5) Cross-check billing_export_2026-03-10.csv shows credit event timestamped after model rollout (2026-03-08 03:12:45 UTC).
comments:
2026-03-10 - Maya Thompson (Customer):
We found a credit memo that seems to have been auto-generated after the open-llama-13b-v2 rollout. We did not request any refund and this breaks our month-end. Please advise ASAP.

2026-03-10 - Carlos Rivera (Support):
Acknowledged. Opening ticket and escalating to Billing. Can you confirm whether you saw any emails about fee adjustments around Mar 8-9? Also sharing your billing org ID for internal lookup.

2026-03-11 - Janelle Kim (Billing):
Preliminary check: CM-2026-03-09-77 was created by an automated adjustment workflow tied to a post-deployment metering reconciliation job that reclassified some tokens from "trial-credit" to "promo-credit" for customers enrolled in the rollout. Investigating whether BrightHealth was part of that cohort. Not yet applied as a refund (no payout), only a credit memo entry. Will follow up with ledger entries.

2026-03-11 - Arjun Patel (SRE):
Checked metering batch id mb-2026-03-08-19. There was an automated job that reprocessed historical prefix cache usage for some customers post-rollout; job completed at 2026-03-08T03:12:45Z. Need Billing to confirm mapping from job output to credit generation rules.

2026-03-12 - Carlos Rivera (Support):
Billing scheduled a reconciliation run today. Customer requests an audit trail and a hold on any auto-adjustment that would generate a payout. Notifying Finance and Customer Success.

2026-03-12 - BrightHealth (Customer Finance):
Our CFO flagged this and wants written confirmation that our February invoice won't be reissued without approval. Also request a CSV export of ledger entries for Feb and Mar for internal audit.
investigation_notes: Billing findings so far: automated adjustment pipeline flagged token-class tagging change after model rollout; rule 'reclassify-trial-to-promo' triggered generation of CM-2026-03-09-77 for a subset of customers. BrightHealth appears to have been incorrectly included due to a tag mismatch on their org metadata (legacy flag: 'pilot_enrollment=true'). Engineering verified metering reprocess (mb-2026-03-08-19) touched historical rows for us-east and produced delta rows. No external payout initiated; the credit memo is an accounting document. Next steps: Billing to reverse the credit memo or convert to internal memo pending customer approval, produce full ledger export, and update the runbook to exclude dedicated/enterprise orgs from this automated rule until opt-in is explicit.
resolution_notes:
Pending - Billing will not issue a cash refund. Options proposed to customer: 1) Void CM-2026-03-09-77 and restore original invoice state (preferred by customer). 2) Convert CM into an internal adjustment that does not alter previously reconciled invoices and provide a balancing entry on the Mar statement. Billing to perform void action after receiving customer confirmation.
Actions completed: Billing has flagged CM-2026-03-09-77 as 'on-hold' at 2026-03-12 14:30 UTC. Support provided ledger export (billing_ledger_org-brighthealth-01_2026-02-2026-03.csv) to customer. Engineering created INT-418 to patch automated rule and prevent future cohort mismatches.
Follow-ups: Billing to confirm void and provide updated invoice PDFs; CS to coordinate with BrightHealth to sign-off on approach; Engineering to land exclusion fix in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/349. Expected closure date: 2026-03-15.
workaround: Customer instructed to place committed capacity increases on hold in Console until billing confirms. Provided ledger export for immediate reconciliation by their finance team.
next_steps: Billing to confirm whether to Void CM-2026-03-09-77 or convert to internal adjustment (due 2026-03-13).
Customer to confirm preferred option (expected by 2026-03-13).
Engineering to merge exclusion fix (INT-418) and monitor next automated run.
Support to update ticket and attach new invoice PDFs once void/conversion complete.
